answer: Tetrad runs MPC among four parties with an honest majority, and the lagoon of the protocol is that one corrupt party cannot break privacy or correctness. The oasis of the design is a preprocessing phase that prepares correlated randomness, so the online phase is only a few rounds. A consortium of four independent organizations can jointly verify that an applicant is unique, and a glacier of sockpuppet accounts fails because the honest majority outvotes any single corrupt participant.
